name: Save Bulk Gmail Attachments
description: A Chrome extension: select emails in Gmail, click once, and every attachment lands in the right Google Drive folder or a ZIP. Read-only (can't send/delete), Google CASA Tier 2 verified. Free 7 attachments/day; Pro $9/mo or $39.99/yr per Gmail account. Targets bookkeepers, accountants, recruiters, ops (company-stated).

mentions.indieAngle: Do the KSeF/biuro-rachunkowe version: pull every invoice PDF/XML from client emails into per-client folders (or straight into the accountant's system) for 29 zł/mo.

whyItPrints: Accountants get dozens of client invoices by email every month and have to download them one by one. Tiny tool, obvious search intent, translated into 11 languages.
whyThisMatters:
Bookkeepers pay so a pile of Gmail attachments lands in the right Drive folder, or in a zip. You select the emails and click once. The extension can read the mail. It cannot send or delete. Google has checked it. The free tier is a handful of attachments a day. The paid plan is per Gmail account, monthly or yearly. Accountants, recruiters, and ops people are the pitch.

The company is in Czechia and started in 2025. The Stripe subscriptions have climbed almost every month this year. The founder puts the user count well above the paying subscriptions, so I am not treating those as the same number. The site is translated into several languages.

You pay so invoice day is not a folder of downloads.

The free plan is seven attachments a day. The paid plan is the one bookkeepers keep, because a month of client invoices is more than seven files.
